class.name: InteriorMaterial
class.brief_description: Windows with rooms behind them, and no geometry inside.
class.description: For a building's front: each window shows a room behind the glass, worked out per pixel from where the camera looks in (interior mapping), with walls, floor and ceiling in its own colors, sometimes blinds partly down and something standing in the room. Its UVs set the windows: [member rooms] across and down each UV square. A [member facade_texture] whose alpha is [code]0[/code] where the glass is lays the wall round the windows; without one, the whole surface is windows, with frames between them. By day the rooms are dim behind the glass, which reflects the sky. At night ([TimeOfDay]'s [code]time_of_day_night[/code]), [member lit_rooms] of them light up, a few at a time as it gets dark, most warm and some cooler.

members.member: The building's front: its alpha is [code]0[/code] where the glass is and the rooms show, [code]1[/code] for the wall.
The color of the window frames.
How wide the frames are round each window, as a part of the window.
The color of most rooms' lights; some are cooler.
How bright a lit room is.
How many rooms light up at night, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
How deep the rooms are, as a part of a window's width.
How many windows across and down each UV square has, each with a room behind it.
